events.body: Inline minimised carrier intake record MD-2798: wrong parcel matched to internal label reference WP-4059; reporting customer Lorcan Grimshaw and collection address verified in the carrier intake process. Do not copy the other recipient’s address into this thread. Collection is allowed from the reporting customer.
The courier left someone else’s parcel. It is unopened. Can you arrange collection? My own order has not arrived.
Please collect sealed parcel WP-4059 from Lorcan using MD-2798’s verified address and saved contact. Do not ask Lorcan to open or forward it. Track their own outstanding order separately.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.
